justification: Inspected [TextElementMatchers.java](./javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/lexicalpreservation/TextElementMatchers.java), [NodeText.java](./javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/lexicalpreservation/NodeText.java), and [TextElementMatcher.java](./javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/lexicalpreservation/TextElementMatcher.java). The class is a tiny package-private helper with only 2 static factory methods and a single external dependency on `Node`; repo-wide search found only one client class (`NodeText`) calling it, and only twice (`byNode` in `findChild` / `tryToFindChild`), with no other references to `TextElementMatchers` anywhere in `javaparser-core` or tests. This is not enough fan-in/fan-out for hub-like modularization.
